response.rationale: Acute febrile meningoencephalitis with neutrophilic CSF pleocytosis, positive culture, and ring-enhancing lesion on follow-up MRI strongly favor a pyogenic abscess over brainstem encephalitis or MS relapse; MS history is background, not the acute process.

rejected.why: Lacks infectious markers (positive culture, neutrophilic CSF, ring enhancement) and fever/neck stiffness are not explained by isolated brainstem inflammation.
Only supports chronic MS history; acute presentation with infection and abscess-like imaging contradicts active demyelination.
